# Calendar Events

Manage calendar events in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::calendarEvents()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Calendar\Events` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one |

## Endpoints

- `events.cancel`
- `events.create`
- `events.info`
- `events.list`
- `events.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `activity_type_id` | Filter by activity type UUID |
| `attendee` | Filter by attendee: [type =&gt; contact, id =&gt; uuid] (contacts only) |
| `done` | Filter by completion status (boolean) |
| `ends_after` | Start of the period for which to return events (ISO 8601 format) |
| `ids` | Array of event UUIDs |
| `link` | Filter by linked entity (object with id and type) |
| `starts_before` | End of the period for which to return events (ISO 8601 format) |
| `task_id` | Filter events by task UUID |
| `term` | Searches for a term in title or description |
| `user_id` | Filter events by user UUID |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `starts_at` | Sort by event start date/time |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `ATTENDEE_TYPES` | `user`, `contact` |
| `CREATE_FIELDS` | `title`, `description`, `activity_type_id`, `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `location`, `work_type_id`, `attendees`, `links` |
| `FILTER_ATTENDEE_TYPES` | `contact` |
| `LINK_TYPES` | `contact`, `company`, `deal` |
| `REQUIRED_ON_CREATE` | `title`, `activity_type_id`, `starts_at`, `ends_at` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `title`, `description`, `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `location`, `work_type_id`, `attendees`, `links` |

### `forAttendee()`

```php
forAttendee(string $attendeeType, string $attendeeId, array $options = []): array
```

Get events for a specific attendee

events.list filters on contact attendees only. Before v2.2.12 `user`
was accepted here too; use forUser() for a user's events.

- `$attendeeType` — Type of attendee: contact
- `$attendeeId` — UUID of the attendee
- `$options` — Additional options

### `forLink()`

```php
forLink(string $linkType, string $linkId, array $options = []): array
```

Get events linked to a specific entity

- `$linkType` — Type of link (contact, company, deal)
- `$linkId` — UUID of the linked entity
- `$options` — Additional options

## Examples

Get all events:

```php
$events = Teamleader::calendarEvents()->list();
```

Get events for a specific user:

```php
$events = Teamleader::calendarEvents()->forUser("user-uuid");
```

Get events within a date range:

```php
$events = Teamleader::calendarEvents()->list([
    "ends_after" => "2025-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
    "starts_before" => "2025-12-31T23:59:59+00:00"
]);
```

Create a new calendar event:

```php
$event = Teamleader::calendarEvents()->create([
    "title" => "Meeting with stakeholders",
    "activity_type_id" => "activity-type-uuid",
    "starts_at" => "2025-02-04T16:00:00+00:00",
    "ends_at" => "2025-02-04T18:00:00+00:00",
    "attendees" => [
        ["type" => "user", "id" => "user-uuid"]
    ]
]);
```

Update an existing event:

```php
$event = Teamleader::calendarEvents()->update("event-uuid", [
    "title" => "Updated meeting title",
    "starts_at" => "2025-02-04T17:00:00+00:00"
]);
```

Cancel an event (for all attendees):

```php
$result = Teamleader::calendarEvents()->cancel("event-uuid");
```

Search events by term:

```php
$events = Teamleader::calendarEvents()->search("coffee");
```
